notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five other creatures.
"Angel" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
description:
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five other creatures.
When the creatures die as Angels due to Arcane Adaptation, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers five times.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Arcane Adaptation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability from step 1, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
